entities.title: Revised dimensional-weight tiers effective
entities.detail: Tier boundaries moved. 31 SKUs reclassified upward with no change to the products themselves.

entities.title: Staged bid rollout — tranche 2 of 2 deferred

entities.title: Two inbound consolidations delayed 1 day
